intro: This quest is a critical step in defending the Stonewrought Dam from a suspected Dark Iron plot. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII tasks adventurers with gathering rare chemical and organic reagents from across Loch Modan to concoct a defusing mixture. Without these components, the defenders will be unable to neutralize the explosives planted beneath the massive stonework.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Begin collecting the disarming materials immediately, friend. Lurker Venom can be found on the indigenous spiders in Loch Modan. Crocolisk tears are found here in the Loch as well. But a Mo'Grosh crystal will be very difficult to procure. The ogres to the northeast mine them but the crystals are a very rare commodity.
We need to be prepared to defuse a Dark Iron attack! Return to me once you've collected the needed items and I will prepare the mixture.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the needed items? Time is of the essence!!
